plugins.name: gams-standards
plugins.description: Read and cite the open asset-management standards on GAMS Standards (questionnaires, templates, reference documents, data schemas, glossaries and FAQs) straight from your AI assistant, read-only. Built using the AlisX Platform (alisx.com).

plugins.name: gams-publisher
plugins.description: Run your GAMS working groups and collections from your AI assistant with your own GAMS permissions: read groups, files, actions, discussions, collections and analytics, and make changes only if you allow them. Built using the AlisX Platform (alisx.com).
